areas.title: Vulnerability Datasets & CWE Validation
areas.overview: Much of vulnerability-detection research rests on datasets that link CVEs to the code changes that fixed them. This work traces that provenance at scale and examines whether the assigned CWE labels are consistent with the code they describe.
points: Dataset reliability for downstream security research

areas.title: Architectural Security & Broken Access Control
areas.overview: Many access-control weaknesses cannot be seen in a single function: they depend on where authorization is enforced across an application. This ongoing work studies architectural security anti-patterns and asks what contextual evidence is needed to understand such vulnerabilities.
points: Minimum Diagnostic Context and staged code-context analysis
The contextual evidence needed to understand security vulnerabilities

areas.title: AI-Assisted Security Research
areas.overview: Exploring where large language models and learning-based methods can support security analysis, and how to evaluate them carefully, with experimental workflows that others can reproduce.
points: LLM-assisted vulnerability analysis and secure code evaluation
Security evaluation and reproducible experimental workflows

areas.title: Applied Machine Learning
areas.overview: Before moving into software security, I worked on applied machine learning in industrial and research settings: from network intrusion detection and synthetic biomedical data to safety optimisation in automotive simulation.
points: Graph neural networks and temporal knowledge graphs
Intrusion detection and network traffic analysis
